profile.headline: Software Engineer @ CIBC | UofT Computer Science Specialist Graduate
profile.summary: Highly motivated and skilled software developer with a background in cyber security. Proficient in multiple programming languages and frameworks including Java, Python, JavaScript, Node.js, Django, React.js, SQL.  I am an enthusiastic, positive, and collaborative professional, eager to continue my journey in the tech industry, and keen on advancing my skills. Please feel free to reach out and connect. I'm always eager to expand my network, especially with those who share a passion for technology. I value the opportunity to share and learn from a variety of viewpoints and experiences.

positions.title: Mathematics Tutor
positions.description:
• Initiated and led comprehensive math tutoring programs, collaborating with a team to create study plans, problem sets, and innovative learning initiatives. 
• Successfully provided concurrent tutoring sessions for multiple students, fostering a collaborative and supportive learning environment in an online and in person setting.

positions.title: Application Security Engineer
positions.description:
• Orchestrated and enhanced security testing initiatives for applications, overseeing both Static Application Security Testing (SAST) and Dynamic Application Security Testing (DAST). 
• Achieved a significant reduction of high vulnerabilities by up to 90% in each application. Coordinated automation jobs through Jenkins and Python, ensuring 100% scanning coverage, including containers and third-party tools. 
• Implemented and refined security test cases using Cypress for integration into the CI/CD pipeline, evaluating endpoints for authorization, authentication, and other critical security aspects. 
• Provided support to developers and stakeholders, contributing to SOC2 compliance and minimizing the risk register.
